posts.title: Free Classroom Visits for Students
posts.description: Would you like a rescued animal to visit with your students? We are scheduling animal visits. Our educational services are free-of-charge. To set up a classroom visit, email us at info@harvesthomesanctuary.org. We want to support our students and teachers every step of the way.
